text:
mari: Quick sync request — planning a staggered design partner cohort for the upcoming private pilot. want to align on intake fields, acceptance gates, and what we promise partners for observability/data access

alex_r: +1. Are we doing a single intake form or a two-step (interest -> technical eligibility)?

june: I vote two-step. first step is lightweight (use-case + willingness to run a short test), second step collects infra/network details and expected RPS. helps us avoid early churn.

mari: agree. draft idea: step1 = company, primary contact, product area, non-binding pilot goals, regulatory scope (yes/no). step2 = infra type (VPC/onprem), preferred model variants, data residency, SSO/KMS needs, and a checklist for test credentials.

alex_r: for step2 we should add a toggle for "observability access": what granularity partner allows (token-level traces, request logs, aggregated metrics). this affects what we can surface in Console for their private instance.

mari: good call. also we need clear acceptance gates for each cohort wave: must-have infra set up, onboarding checklist completed, and two successful smoke runs within SLA. thoughts on sample size per wave?

june: propose small pilot wave = 3 partners (fast feedback), wave 2 = 8 partners (scale validation). keep waves 3-4 optional depending on infra work.

tom: legal note — any partner access to logs with PII requires a tailored DSA and explicit consent in the intake. also need to standardize an NDA + data processing addendum template for fin/reg customers.

mari: noted. tom, can you provide a minimal DPA snippet we can link from the intake? avoid asking partners to sign full contracts before they opt in.

tom: yes — I'll draft a one-page DPA summary + link to full contract. includes what we collect, retention windows, and opt-out process.

alex_r: operational ask: set a "support runway" per partner — e.g., 4 dev days during onboarding, then escalation SLA. we should capture that in the intake so we can budget engineering.

june: also capture expected feedback cadence: weekly check-ins for first 3 weeks, then biweekly. partners should provide acceptance tests and a small prompt set for quality monitoring.

mari: success criteria proposal: 1) integration stability (<= 1 incident/week), 2) response quality baseline met for provided prompts (we'll compare model outputs to partner test set), 3) product adoption signal (feature usage or pilot ROI metric).

alex_r: add a rollback/fallback plan requirement: if model quality regresses during rollout, we switch routing to a fallback model automatically. include that as a contractual "safety net" in the intake.

mari: timeline: draft intake + DPA by end of week, pilot wave 1 invite list by next Tue, onboarding docs + runbook by next Fri. can we commit to that?

june: yes, I'll own onboarding docs and checklists.

alex_r: I'll scope the required observability flags and a minimal config template for partners.

tom: I'll produce the DPA one-pager and NDA template.

mari: dp-bot: please create candidate spreadsheet and calendar invites for wave1 outreach once we have the list.

dp-bot: created board "staggered-design-cohort" and a shared spreadsheet stub under /product/pilots. added Mari, Alex_R, June, Tom as editors. :white_check_mark:

mari: thanks — follow-up: can each of you drop any must-have intake fields in that sheet by EOD tomorrow? short list only.

alex_r: will add infra, observability choice, acceptable latency targets.

june: will add onboarding support hours, expected sample prompts, and contact for security scans.

tom: will add contract links and required compliance flags (SOC2, ISO).

mari: perfect. wrapping up here, we'll reconvene Thurs 10am to approve the final intake form before outreach.
